title: Uyo Akawana Surah
intro: Fungidzira mweya unozvininipisa uchisvika kune mumwe weVatumwa vaAllah nemoyo wakazara nemwoyo wese uye nechido chakadzama chekudzidza. Asi panguva iyoyo chaiyo, munhu ane pfuma nechinzvimbo akabata pfungwa dzeMutumwa, uye chiso chake chakatsvuka kumeso akatarisa kune aitsvaga. Chakatevera chaive chitsauko chose cheKorani, chakatumirwa kugadzirisa Mutumwa nekukudza mweya waiuya uchitsvaga.
clues: Ndakauya kuMutumwa waAllah nemoyo wakavhurika uye nechido chakadzama chekutungamirirwa
Ndakanga ndisina chinzvimbo chenyika chekupa, mweya unozvininipisa chete waitsvaga chokwadi
Maziso angu enyama aisagona kuona, asi kuona kwangu kwemweya kwaive kwakajeka
Ndakasvika panguva isina kukodzera, apo Mutumwa akanga akabatikana nemunhu ane simba guru
Ndakabatwa nehasha, asi Allah akapindura nekururamisa kwaMwari
Ini ndiri Abdullah ibn Umm Maktum, shamwari yakazvipira ine nyaya yakafuridzira Surah Abasa.
